description: Accepted differences for fidelity/run.js (see lib/accepted.js). DENY BY DEFAULT: a difference fails the gate unless its exact key appears here. Keys are PER DIFF, not per page, and are printed by the gate so an entry can be copied straight from its output — `fidelity:L1: {url} {-|+} "{text}"`, `fidelity:L2: {url} {field} golden={n} converted={n}`, `fidelity:L3: {url} {type} {path}#{anchor}`. Accepting one difference on a page leaves every other difference on it blocking. Each entry needs a `disposition` (wont-fix | upstream | harness-limit | deferred) and a non-empty `note`; a malformed entry fails the gate. Accepted differences are still PRINTED on every run and written to build/diff/fidelity-report.json. A STALE entry (its difference no longer occurs) FAILS the gate, so this cannot become a record of what used to be broken. A page-level `error` (no main-content container) is deliberately NOT acceptable: there is no diff to judge, so accepting it would mute the whole page. Ships EMPTY — prefer fixing a difference, and reach for `harness-limit` only after checking the RENDERED output, since a comparator blind spot is a harness bug (the admonition-title strip fixed on 2026-08-17 was one).
